name: Logitech
description: Established in 1981 in Switzerland, Logitech is a computer accessories brand that manufactures keyboards, mice, speakers, webcams, and other equipment. Logitech products are cleverly and intuitively designed to help customers get the most out of their devices, and this expertise is reflected through the number of international industry awards the company has won. Over the years, Logitech has also expanded their product range to include home entertainment and music and gaming accessories.
